focus: Explain the magnitude response of a first-order RC low-pass filter. Control resistance, capacitance, and frequency; show angular frequency, time constant, cutoff frequency, gain, and the -3 dB point.
audience: Electrical engineering undergraduate familiar with complex impedance
excerpt: For a first-order RC low-pass filter, H(j omega) = 1 / (1 + j omega R C). Its magnitude is 1 / sqrt(1 + (omega R C)^2), where omega = 2 pi f. The cutoff frequency is f_c = 1/(2 pi R C), at which the magnitude equals 1/sqrt(2), approximately -3.01 dB.
